statement: The tower/gate job runs the gate's tooling from the commit it judges, so a change to the gate's scripts or rules is judged by its own version; the pinned gate (scripts/lib/gate_pin.py, D-070), which judges with the base's tooling and runs the head's only as advisory, is not used on GitHub. Found in the independent review of THREAT-gate (tampering) and THREAT-planning (elevation of privilege); entering the merge queue takes write access to the repository.
reason: Fixed 2026-11-19: the job `pinned` of .github/workflows/tower-gate.yml (installed, c262659) runs the base's gate_pin.py overlay and verify-commit --stages-only, and tower/gate needs it green. The overlay puts back the base's version of what the stages are made of that the change touches, and removes what it adds there: the gate files of GATE_FILE; their import closure in scripts/lib (static ast and heredoc imports, a module name built from a literal start); the top-level scripts and files the base's stage commands run or read by path (scripts/gate-check's "$root/scripts/generate" and scripts/schema-compat, "$(dirname "$0")/lib/x.py", ROOT / 'scripts' / 'x', .gitleaks.toml) with their own closure; the toolchain (TOOLCHAIN_FILE); and every registry owner whose key the closure's code reads (config.get literals, ou_config_value) when the change alters that key. The head's tests still run the head's code, as code under test; a change to the verifier that chooses them is a GATE_FILE change and asks an approved decision, judged by the base's pr metadata stage.
